# credentials

Authenticated-scan credentials and credential stores.

- Toolset name: `credentials`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 9 (4 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_credential`

**Create credential** · mutating

Create a credential for authenticated scans. `type` selects the kind (up, usk, cc, pw, snmp, snmpv3, or a store-backed cs_* type). Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_algorithm` | string | no | SNMPv3 auth algorithm: md5 or sha1 |
| `certificate` | string | no | PEM certificate (cc) |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `community` | string | no | SNMP community string (snmp) |
| `credential_store_id` | string | no | Credential store identifier (cs_* types; see openvas_list_credential_stores) |
| `host_identifier` | string | no | Write-only external host identifier (cs_* types) |
| `login` | string | no | Login/username (up, usk, snmp, snmpv3) |
| `name` | string | yes | Credential name |
| `password` | string | no | Password (up, pw, snmpv3) or key passphrase (usk) |
| `privacy_algorithm` | string | no | SNMPv3 privacy algorithm: aes or des |
| `privacy_password` | string | no | SNMPv3 privacy password |
| `private_key` | string | no | PEM private key (usk) |
| `type` | string | yes | Credential kind: up (username+password), usk (username+SSH key), cc (client certificate), pw (password only), snmp (v1/v2c), snmpv3, or store-backed cs_up, cs_usk, cs_cc, cs_pw, cs_pgp, cs_smime, cs_snmp |
| `vault_id` | string | no | Write-only external vault identifier (cs_* types) |

### `openvas_delete_credential`

**Delete credential** · destructive

Delete a credential (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently). Fails with 409 if a target still uses it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_credential`

**Get credential** · read-only

Get one credential by UUID (metadata only, no secrets).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_get_credential_store`

**Get credential store** · read-only

Get one credential store (connection settings; preference values are write-only and never returned).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_credential_stores`

**List credential stores** · read-only

List the backend credential stores that `cs_*` credentials can be created in. Answers 501 on gvmd builds without credential stores.

This tool takes no parameters.

### `openvas_list_credentials`

**List credentials** · read-only

List credentials usable for authenticated scans (metadata only, no secrets).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_update_credential`

**Update credential** · destructive

Update a credential (the type cannot change). Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_algorithm` | string | no | md5 or sha1 |
| `certificate` | string | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `community` | string | no |  |
| `credential_store_id` | string | no |  |
| `host_identifier` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the credential to update |
| `login` | string | no |  |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `password` | string | no |  |
| `privacy_algorithm` | string | no | aes or des |
| `privacy_password` | string | no |  |
| `private_key` | string | no |  |
| `vault_id` | string | no |  |

### `openvas_update_credential_store`

**Update credential store** · destructive

Update a credential store's connection settings. Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged; preference values are write-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `host` | string | no | Store host |
| `id` | string | yes | Credential store identifier |
| `path` | string | no | Store path |
| `port` | integer | no | Store port (0-65535) (min 0, max 65535) |
| `preferences` | array<object> | no | Write-only preferences (e.g. tokens) for the store backend Each item: `name` (string, required): Preference name; `value` (string, required): Preference value (write-only, never returned). |

### `openvas_verify_credential_store`

**Verify credential store** · mutating

Ask gvmd to verify a credential store's connection.
